name: Lud's Smithy
desc1: Arguably the warmest building in the city, the forge keeps things
desc2: quite toasty in here.  The red glow of the forge casts an odd light
desc3: about the room.  You see a few items hanging from the walls, and a few
desc4: in a pile behind the master smith.  He greets you with a quick nod of
desc5: his head while he continues to bang away at his latest creation.
